deliverables.name: Business card
deliverables.logo: front, centred or in a top corner; the back may carry the mark alone
deliverables.colour: one ground per side; the back can carry the primary
deliverables.avoid: more than two type sizes; text closer than 4 mm to the edge

deliverables.name: Letterhead
deliverables.logo: top left or top centre, at clear space from the edge
deliverables.colour: light paper; colour only in the logo and one rule
deliverables.avoid: full-bleed colour; a pattern behind text

deliverables.name: Envelope
deliverables.logo: top left of the front, or centred on the flap
deliverables.colour: neutral paper, the mark in the primary
deliverables.avoid: addresses set in a display face

deliverables.name: App screen
deliverables.logo: the mark alone in the top bar or on the launch screen
deliverables.colour: surface ground; the primary for the main action only
deliverables.avoid: the full lockup squeezed into a top bar

deliverables.name: Website home
deliverables.logo: top left in the header
deliverables.colour: surface ground, the primary for one action
deliverables.avoid: several competing accents; the logo used as hero text

deliverables.name: Social post
deliverables.logo: small, in a corner, or the post itself for an announcement
deliverables.colour: one ground from the palette; the pattern is welcome
deliverables.avoid: the logo at several sizes in one post

deliverables.name: Profile picture
deliverables.size: 400 x 400 px, shown as a circle
deliverables.logo: the mark alone, centred, with clear space inside the circle
deliverables.colour: primary or surface ground
deliverables.avoid: a wordmark too small to read inside a circle

deliverables.name: Shopping bag
deliverables.logo: centred on the front, large
deliverables.colour: one solid ground; kraft or neutral for handmade and organic brands
deliverables.avoid: small text on the side panel

deliverables.name: Takeaway bag
deliverables.logo: front, upper third
deliverables.colour: kraft or neutral paper, the mark in one colour
deliverables.avoid: full-colour print on kraft

deliverables.name: Product box
deliverables.logo: front face; the mark alone on a side
deliverables.colour: primary or neutral ground; the pattern inside or on a side
deliverables.avoid: the logo across a fold

deliverables.name: Pastry box
deliverables.logo: lid, centred
deliverables.colour: white or kraft, the mark in the primary
deliverables.avoid: a pattern under the logo

deliverables.name: Product label
deliverables.logo: top, the product name below in the display face
deliverables.colour: neutral ground with one accent
deliverables.avoid: legal text in the display face

deliverables.name: Sticker
deliverables.logo: the mark alone, centred
deliverables.colour: primary ground with the reversed mark
deliverables.avoid: the full lockup inside a small circle

deliverables.name: Room key card
deliverables.logo: front, centred, alone
deliverables.colour: dark or primary ground
deliverables.avoid: room numbers or guest details on the card

deliverables.name: Menu
deliverables.size: A4 or one third of A4
deliverables.logo: top centre
deliverables.colour: paper neutral, one accent for section heads
deliverables.avoid: dishes or prices invented for the mockup: use text bars

deliverables.name: Storefront sign
deliverables.logo: the full lockup, centred
deliverables.colour: primary or dark ground, the reversed logo
deliverables.avoid: hairlines that vanish at a distance

deliverables.name: Wayfinding sign
deliverables.logo: the mark alone, small, at the bottom
deliverables.colour: surface ground, text colour from the palette
deliverables.avoid: decorative type for directions

deliverables.name: Invoice
deliverables.logo: top left
deliverables.colour: white, colour in the logo only
deliverables.avoid: invented amounts: use text bars

deliverables.name: Email signature
deliverables.logo: left of the name, at most 120 px wide
deliverables.colour: text colour, one rule in the primary
deliverables.avoid: a signature that is only an image

deliverables.name: Vehicle side
deliverables.logo: large on the side, the horizontal lockup
deliverables.colour: one solid ground
deliverables.avoid: the logo across a door seam

deliverables.name: Takeaway cup
deliverables.logo: on the sleeve or the cup, centred, one colour
deliverables.colour: cup in the light neutral or kraft, sleeve in the primary
deliverables.avoid: the full lockup wrapped around the curve

deliverables.name: Tote bag
deliverables.logo: centred on the front, large
deliverables.colour: natural cotton or one palette ground, the mark in one colour
deliverables.avoid: fine hairlines that print badly on fabric
